messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":13,"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":13,"text":"But they made this plan among themselves, that they would leave the multitude of the heathen, and go out into a more distant region, where mankind had never lived,","verse":41},{"chapter":13,"text":"that there they might keep their statutes which they had not kept in their own land.","verse":42},{"chapter":13,"text":"They entered by the narrow passages of the river Euphrates.","verse":43},{"chapter":13,"text":"For the Most High then did signs for them, and stopped the springs of the River until they had passed over.","verse":44},{"chapter":13,"text":"For through that country there was a long way to go, namely, of a year and a half. The same region is called Arzareth.","verse":45},{"chapter":13,"text":"Then they lived there until the latter time. Now when they begin to come again,","verse":46},{"chapter":13,"text":"the Most High stops the springs of the River again, that they may go through. Therefore you saw the multitude gathered together with peace.","verse":47},{"chapter":13,"text":"But those who are left behind of your people are those who are found within my holy border.","verse":48},{"chapter":13,"text":"It will be therefore when he will destroy the multitude of the nations that are gathered together, he will defend the people who remain.","verse":49},{"chapter":13,"text":"Then he will show them very many wonders.”","verse":50},{"chapter":13,"text":"Then I said, “O sovereign Lord, explain this to me: Why have I seen the man coming up from the midst of the sea?”","verse":51},{"chapter":13,"text":"He said to me, as no one can explore or know what is in the depths of the sea, even so no man on earth can see my Son, or those who are with him, except in the time of his day.","verse":52},{"chapter":13,"text":"This is the interpretation of the dream which you saw, and for this only you are enlightened about this,","verse":53},{"chapter":13,"text":"for you have forsaken your own ways, and applied your diligence to mine, and have searched out my law.","verse":54},{"chapter":13,"text":"You have ordered your life in wisdom, and have called understanding your mother.","verse":55},{"chapter":13,"text":"Therefore I have shown you this, for there is a reward laid up with the Most High. It will be, after another three days I will speak other things to you, and declare to you mighty and wondrous things.”","verse":56},{"chapter":13,"text":"Then I went out and passed into the field, giving praise and thanks greatly to the Most High because of his wonders, which he did from time to time,","verse":57},{"chapter":13,"text":"and because he governs the time, and such things as happen in their seasons. So I sat there three days.","verse":58}]}
